C074.name: Songea Municipal Council
C074.documented: heavy Msimu rain, floods on the Ruvuma tributaries, and strong winds

area.en: Songea Municipal: hillside town and river valleys
area.sw: Manispaa ya Songea: mji wa milimani na mabonde ya mito

risk.en: This area is a hilly town where heavy rain floods valley streets and cuts gullies through hillside settlements, and lightning is frequent.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo mvua kubwa hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni na kuchimba makorongo kwenye makazi ya milimani, na radi hupiga mara kwa mara.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains clear, build away from gully edges and stream banks and fit lightning arresters on public buildings.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi, kujenga mbali na kingo za makorongo na vijito na kuweka vizuia radi kwenye majengo ya umma.

C077.name: Mbinga Town Council
C077.documented: heavy rain and landslides on the Matengo highlands, and valley floods

area.sw: Mji wa Mbinga: nyanda za juu za kahawa

risk.en: This area is a highland coffee town on steep slopes where heavy rain causes landslides and erosion and hailstorms damage crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa kahawa wa nyanda za juu kwenye miteremko mikali ambapo mvua kubwa husababisha maporomoko na mmomonyoko na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep terraces and trees on slopes and build away from steep cuts and gullies.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutunza matuta na miti kwenye miteremko na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na makorongo.

C075.name: Madaba District Council
C075.documented: heavy rain, valley floods, and strong winds

area.sw: Madaba: mashamba ya miombo na misitu

risk.en: This area has miombo farmland and forest where dry-season fires spread fast and wildlife from nearby reserves raids crops.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya miombo na misitu ambapo moto wa kiangazi husambaa haraka na wanyamapori kutoka hifadhi jirani huvamia mazao.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to burn early and under control, keep fire breaks and use community deterrents against wildlife.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuchoma mapema kwa udhibiti, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama.

C076.name: Mbinga District Council
C076.documented: heavy rain, landslides, and floods on the highland valleys

area.en: Mbinga DC: steep coffee slopes and Ruhuhu valley
area.sw: Mbinga DC: miteremko mikali ya kahawa na bonde la Ruhuhu

risk.en: This area has steep coffee slopes prone to landslides and the Ruhuhu valley and coal areas where rivers flood farms and roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina miteremko mikali ya kahawa inayokumbwa na maporomoko na bonde la Ruhuhu na maeneo ya makaa ya mawe ambapo mito hufurika mashamba na barabara.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to keep slopes planted, build away from river banks and know flood-prone crossings.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kuacha mimea kwenye miteremko, kujenga mbali na kingo za mito na kujua vivuko vinavyofurika.

C079.name: Namtumbo District Council
C079.documented: heavy rain, Ruvuma floods, and a sharp dry season

area.en: Namtumbo: Selous edge and uranium areas
area.sw: Namtumbo: pembezoni mwa Selous na maeneo ya urani

risk.en: This area borders the Nyerere (Selous) reserve, where elephants raid crops and dry-season fires spread, and rains cut remote roads.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na hifadhi ya Nyerere (Selous), ambapo tembo huvamia mazao na moto wa kiangazi husambaa, na mvua hukata barabara za mbali.

advice.en: For those living and farming here, it helps to use community deterrents, keep fire breaks and keep food and medicine reserves before the rains.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kulima hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuweka njia za kuzuia moto na kuweka akiba ya chakula na dawa kabla ya mvua.

C078.name: Nyasa District Council
C078.documented: Lake Nyasa floods and large waves, boat accidents, heavy rain, and earthquake

area.en: Nyasa: Lake Nyasa shore and Livingstone slopes
area.sw: Nyasa: ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa na miteremko ya Livingstone

risk.en: This area has Lake Nyasa shore villages exposed to sudden storms and strong winds, and steep slopes behind them where landslides and flash floods occur.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina vijiji vya ufukwe wa Ziwa Nyasa vinavyoathiriwa na dhoruba za ghafla na upepo mkali, na miteremko mikali nyuma yake ambapo maporomoko na mafuriko ya ghafla hutokea.

advice.en: For those living and fishing here, it helps to wear life jackets, return to shore when winds rise and build away from steep cuts and stream mouths.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kuvua hapa, ni vyema kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa, kurudi ufukweni upepo unapovuma na kujenga mbali na miinuko mikali na midomo ya vijito.

C073.name: Songea District Council
C073.documented: heavy rain, floods on streams to the Ruvuma, and strong winds

area.en: Songea DC: farmland and the Ruvuma headwaters
area.sw: Songea DC: mashamba na vyanzo vya mto Ruvuma

risk.en: This area has maize and tobacco farmland where dry spells and hail damage crops, and river headwaters that flood crossings in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina mashamba ya mahindi na tumbaku ambapo vipindi vya ukavu na mvua ya mawe huharibu mazao, na vyanzo vya mito vinavyofurika vivuko wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those farming here, it helps to plant early-maturing varieties, keep household food reserves and know flood-prone crossings.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaolima hapa, ni vyema kupanda mbegu zinazokomaa mapema, kuweka akiba ya chakula ya kaya na kujua vivuko vinavyofurika.

C072.name: Tunduru District Council
C072.documented: heavy rain, wet-season floods, dry-season wildfire, and human–wildlife conflict

area.en: Tunduru: Ruvuma border, miombo and gem mining
area.sw: Tunduru: mpaka wa Ruvuma, miombo na uchimbaji wa vito

risk.en: This area borders Mozambique on the Ruvuma river, with miombo where elephants raid crops, gemstone pits that collapse in the rains and remote villages cut off by floods.
risk.sw: Eneo hili linapakana na Msumbiji kando ya mto Ruvuma, lina miombo ambapo tembo huvamia mazao, mashimo ya vito yanayobomoka wakati wa mvua na vijiji vya mbali vinavyotengwa na mafuriko.

advice.en: For those living, farming and mining here, it helps to use community deterrents, fence or backfill pits and keep homes above the river flood line.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kulima na kuchimba hapa, ni vyema kutumia mbinu za jamii kufukuza wanyama, kuzungushia uzio au kufukia mashimo na kujenga juu ya mstari wa mafuriko ya mto.
